title: Digital Services Operation Specialist
description:
Jobs
Digital Services Operation Specialist
Permanent
Full time
€35,000
- €45,000
Annual
Hybrid
(Fino Mornasco, Italy)
D-Orbit is looking for a Digital Services Operation Specialist to join our Space Cloud Business Unit based in Fino Mornasco. You will become part of a dynamic growing group responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Space Cloud services, acting as the primary operational interface between customers, internal engineering teams, and business stakeholders. The role owns the successful execution of customer missions from contract signature through service completion, ensuring delivery on time, quality, and within budget.
You will also work with the team to support and manage the software integration of algorithms and applications within our fleet of Intelligent Network Nodes (INN’s), development of operational procedures and features, contribute to the development of new tools/applications as well as defining new processes to support Space Cloud infrastructure for all current and future INN’s.
Tasks and Responsibilities
Responsible for customer journey, starting from contract signature until completion of the contract.
Support integration and verification activities between customer applications and Space Cloud infrastructure.
Lead onboarding and technical discussions with customers to identify needs and perform requirements breakdown, operational objectives and delivery milestones.
Promote customer satisfaction while protecting D-Orbit's commercial and operational interests.
Adaptive and intuitive approach to solving issues with scheduling conflicts and administrative tasks.
Manage and schedule operations on Space Cloud infrastructure by interacting with the Flight Operations team. Both on ground and in-orbit.
Gather and manage monthly logs and service statistics.
Identify and implement service performance improvements through processes or product requests.
Execute service operation procedures (e.g sending customer the SDK, validating customer application on the EM, scheduling ops, sending final results to customers, etc.)
Proactively review service operations procedures; maintain and update them for continuous improvement.
Ability to meet bespoke contract elements such as new technology integration and operation cocktails.
Contributing to the continuous improvement of team processes and methodologies through development of new tools and applications with key stakeholders.
Qualifications and Requirements
We are looking for individuals with the following skills:
Resilience and ability to work in a fast paced environment.
Ability to work hard in a team setting to meet tight schedules.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively.
At least 2 years’ experience in relevant cloud or digital infrastructure management activities.
Familiarity with using any Linux based distribution and appreciation of application development on Windows and Linux.
Familiarity with typical software development methodologies and release versioning processes. (e.g. Git/Mercurial and CI/CD pipelines)
Understanding of typical Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) to ensure back-end processes complement the front-end interface.
Working knowledge of Python programming language. Ability to inspect Python scripts, understand their structure and debug high level operations
Capability of working autonomously.
Complimentary experience and or skills to the above will be considered.
Experience with test-driven development.
Nice to have skills
Experience with software development sprint management
Experience with software development time/cost estimations
Education
Bachelor's degree in any relevant area such as aerospace engineering, electronic engineering, computer science or automation, software development, with proven experience in participating in projects development.
Language
Full professional proficiency of English language is mandatory.
We offer a base salary range of 35’000€ - 45’000€ gross per year for this role, depending on experience and location, plus a performance-based variable component. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, location, and internal consistency across comparable roles.
Additional Benefits
Meal vouchers
Variable compensation

Serenis platform, including unlimited individual psychotherapy, nutrition, and coaching sessions

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At D-Orbit, we're pioneering the future of space logistics and transportation. Established in 2011, our company has been at the forefront of helping businesses unlock the full potential of the final frontier—profitably and sustainably.
As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a diverse group of highly skilled individuals, all driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. So, if you are passionate about space and ready to take your ambition to new heights, join us in our global mission to push the boundaries of what's possible!

title: Embedded Software Test Engineer
description:

Embedded Software Test Engineer
Permanent
Full time
€40,000
- €46,000
Annual
Hybrid
(Lomazzo , Italy)
Engineering - Systems IVVQ
D-Orbit is looking for a Embedded Software Test Engineer to join our Systems IVVQ team, based in Fino Mornasco, Italy.
In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the software powering our spacecraft. Combining deep expertise in embedded software development and software verification, you will lead the design and development of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) satellite simulators, advanced test environments, and automated verification frameworks that support both embedded and high-performance space applications throughout the entire software lifecycle.
You will drive the evolution of our Verification and Validation infrastructure, enabling the simulation of new sensors and actuators, enhancing automated test capabilities, and improving the software delivery pipeline within a continuous integration environment. Working closely with Software, Systems, AIV, Flight Operations, and other engineering teams, you will contribute to the definition of testing strategies, support spacecraft integration and validation activities, and help deliver robust, mission-critical software for current and future space missions.
Tasks and Responsibilities:
Architecture software design and development of HIL infrastructure components (e.g. satellite sensors and actuators mockups)
Architecture design and debug maintenance of features including integration with software-in the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop test suites
Test scenarios definitions against embedded software requirements
Contribute to the entire application lifecycle, focusing on requirements verification and validation, debugging and integration of flight software with the flight hardware
Preparation of flight software VandV technical documentation
Contributing to the design and continuous improvement of the teams' processes, methodologies and test framework - Support to satellite AIV activities and HW production test
Key technical skills:
3 to 7 years of industry experience in embedded software development
Proven ability to design, develop and deliver an application in any C-family (C/C++) languages
Proven ability to design, develop and deliver an application in Python language
Advanced experience in developing large distributed applications, using design patterns
Advanced knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
Advanced knowledge of any typical embedded communication interfaces such as RS232, RS485, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet
Good familiarity with Git versioning system or any similar DVCS
Good familiarity with using any Linux based distribution and appreciation of application development
Good familiarity with typical software development methodology and release versioning processes
Experience in defining software system specifications and software requirements
Experience in debugging embedded software using standard laboratory equipment
Other skills:
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively
Capability of working in autonomy
Resilience and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work hard in a team setting to meet tight schedules
Nice-to-have skills:
Understanding of SW design and testing lifecycle in regulated environment (ideally ECSS standard)
Knowledge of real-time operating systems (such as RTEMS or FreeRTOS) and/or operating systems targeted for embedded applications (such as any embedded Linux)
Experience using and configuring any common build tool chains or similar development environment (such as ANT, WAF, Makefile, Visual Studio etc.)
Familiarity with OBDH and TMTC architectures used in space systems
Education:
Bachelor, or higher degree, in any relevant area such as software engineering, computer science, physics, automation engineering, electronic engineering, aerospace engineering.
Language:
This role requires professional proficiency in English.

D-Orbit is looking for a PMO Back Office & AI-Driven Data Automation Intern to join our PMO – Operational Excellence team, based in Fino Mornasco.
In this role, you will support the PMO in the execution of the programme reporting cycle, ensuring the collection, validation and consolidation of project data across multiple Business Units.
You will also contribute to improving operational efficiency by analysing repetitive reporting activities and prototyping automation solutions, including the use of AI-based tools for data collection, verification and aggregation.
You will work closely with Project Managers, PMO team members and management stakeholders, contributing to accurate programme reporting, data-driven decision making and the continuous improvement of project governance processes across the organisation.

Programme reporting and back office
Collect and verify the completeness and consistency of progress files submitted by Project Managers

Prepare periodic reporting packages (monthly and ad hoc) and support portfolio reviews
Reconcile project data against corporate sources (ERP, time recording system)
Maintain PMO templates and process documentation
Automation and AI tools
Map the reporting activities with the highest manual workload and identify automation opportunities
Develop scripts and workflows for the extraction, normalisation and automated aggregation of data from heterogeneous files

End-to-end visibility over the programme portfolio of a NewSpace company and its financial control mechanisms

Analytical mindset, accuracy and attention to data quality
Good written and spoken English
Genuine interest in process automation and in the professional use of AI tools
Desirable
Familiarity with project management and project control concepts (WBS, earned value, budget and forecast)

Soft skills
Ability to engage with a range of stakeholders and to chase information tactfully and persistently
Self-organisation and reliability against deadlines in an environment driven by recurring reporting cycles
Discretion in handling financial and project data

Full-time, 6-month internship with expense allowance €800, company canteen (8€ meal vouchers) and structured mentoring. Possible consideration for a longer-term position at the end of the programme.

Permanent

Annual

(Fino Mornasco, Italy)
Regulatory Strategy and Legal Affairs
D-Orbit is looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Regulatory Strategy and Legal Affairs team, based in Fino Mornasco.
In this role, you will support D-Orbit’s commercial activities by drafting, negotiating, and standardising the contracts through which we sell our services and procure the goods and services needed to deliver our missions.
You will work closely with Sales, Procurement, technical and logistics teams, and contribute to enabling our business operations through solid contractual frameworks, regulatory authorisations, and appropriate insurance coverage. You will also support D-Orbit’s subsidiaries within the relevant areas of responsibility.
Key Responsibilities & Tasks:
Contracts and commercial advisory (primary focus)
Draft, review and negotiate sales and procurement contracts for both commercial and institutional projects.
Develop, maintain and update the contractual templates and negotiation playbooks underpinning D-Orbit's current and future business offerings, keeping them aligned with regulatory and market developments, and contributing to the ongoing development of D-Orbit's commercial contract strategy.
Lead or support negotiations with internal stakeholders and external counterparties, and advise business units on pricing, delivery terms, liability, risk allocation and the legal implications of commercial strategies.
Provide guidance on contract lifecycle management and on dispute resolution strategy.
Licensing and authorisation compliance, insurance
Manage the registration of D-Orbit's spacecraft under the Convention on Registration of Objects Launched into Outer Space.
Manage or support the filing and obtaining of telecommunication authorisations from local and international authorities, and of any other permits or licences required to launch and operate D-Orbit's spacecraft.
Support the acquisition of insurance policies necessary for the execution of D-Orbit's activities.
Support the implementation and maintenance of procedures for handling sensitive, including dual-use, information.
Monitor and analyse regulatory developments across the responsibility areas.
Requirements:
Degree in law, preferably obtained in Italy.
Solid experience in a comparable role within a company, consultancy practice or other relevant organisation, with a demonstrable track record in drafting and negotiating sales and procurement contracts.
Working knowledge of the regulatory framework applicable to dual-use goods and technology, space-related licensing procedures in Europe and beyond, and the use of radio frequencies; experience obtaining authorisations, permits or licences from the competent authorities.
Ability to balance legal risk against commercial priorities, with a pragmatic, business-oriented and problem-solving approach.
Proficiency in the use of artificial intelligence tools.
High motivation and the ability to work both autonomously and within interdisciplinary teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Full professional proficiency in the English language is mandatory;
Knowledge of the Italian language and any additional language of the jurisdictions where D-Orbit Group is present will be considered a plus.

description:

Senior Avionics Systems Engineer
Permanent
Full time

(Lomazzo , Italy)
D-Orbit is looking for a Senior Avionics Systems Engineer to join our Avionic Systems Engineer team, based in Lomazzo (CO).
In this role, you will ideally have 10 years of hands-on experience in avionics or complex electronic systems engineering, with a demonstrated ability to lead and mentor engineering teams.
This role calls for a technical leader who can own end-to-end avionics system design, driving architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional activities, and representing the avionics system at program level.
Key Responsibilities
Own and drive the end-to-end avionics platform architecture (functional, logical, physical), including HW/SW/FW partitioning, resource budgets, and scalability strategy across multiple satellite platforms and mission variants.
Lead architectural trade studies, evaluate design options, and make authoritative technical decisions balancing performance, reliability, reuse, cost, and schedule.
Define and enforce the onboard logical architecture: functions, data flows, interfaces, operational modes, and FDIR concepts.
Maintain radiation-awareness at system level and guide subsystem teams in appropriate design margins and mitigation strategies.
Lead system-level requirements definition and interface control for power generation, storage, distribution, and protection. Review PCDU/PDU design and manage power budgets and load profiles.
Lead system-level requirements definition and interface control for Communication and RF domain, including review of Comm architecture and link budgets.
Drive the internal development of Data Handling equipment, through demonstrated knowledge and several years of experience in such discipline, including definition of the internal electronic design of the related equipment in a space domain
Own OBC/OBDH architectural definition, data bus topology (SpaceWire, CAN-FD, MIL-STD-1553, etc.), onboard time management, and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) design.
Define harness system requirements, connector and cable specifications, signal integrity constraints, and shielding/grounding philosophy. Support harness design reviews and integration.
Define and own avionics software requirements and architectural constraints (BSP, RTOS, middleware, application layer). Interface closely with the embedded SW team to ensure compliance with system-level timing, determinism, and FDIR requirements. Familiar with ECSS-E-ST-40 and space SW development standards.
Capture, decompose, and allocate stakeholder needs into system and subsystem requirements with full end-to-end traceability from mission needs through design to verification evidence.
Own requirements consistency and change impact assessment across the avionics baseline.
Lead and coordinate a team of avionics system and subsystem engineers; assign activities, monitor progress, and ensure technical quality of team deliverables.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, structured problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
Participate in design reviews (PDR, CDR, TRR, etc.) both as reviewer and as presenter, ensuring all avionics entry/exit criteria are met.
Required Skills & Knowledge
Education: MSc (or equivalent) in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related STEM discipline. A PhD in a relevant field is considered a plus.
Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in systems engineering for avionics or complex electronic systems, with a significant share of that experience in the space sector (small/medium satellites, launchers, or ground systems).
Demonstrated track record of leading technical teams or acting as system/subsystem lead on flight programs from early phases through AIV/AIT and launch.
Proven experience covering at least three of the four avionics domains: EPS, CDHS, harness, and avionics SW.
Familiarity with typical avionics interfaces/protocols (as applicable): CAN/CAN-FD, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet; space-oriented protocols such as SpaceWire and MIL-STD-1553 are a plus.
Working knowledge of structured engineering standards/processes: ECSS engineering and product assurance principles (preferred) and/or transferable safety-critical frameworks such as DO-178C / DO-254 / ARP4754A, IEC 61508, ISO 26262.
Strong technical documentation skills (requirements, architectures, ICDs, verification artifacts).
Languages: Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory; Italian is a plus.
Deep knowledge of AI tools.
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience with space avionics building blocks (e.g., OBC/OBDH, PCDU/PDU, data handling, IO modules, timing/synchronization distribution).
Participation in environmental test campaigns (e.g., thermal-vac, vibration/shock, EMC), qualification/acceptance planning, and related documentation.
Experience supporting system integration campaigns and failure investigations (lab/production), including structured anomaly management.
Experience contributing to platform/product-line development (reuse strategies, configuration variants, scalable verification/acceptance).
Soft Skills
Strong analytical thinking, systems mindset, and structured problem solving.
Ability to thrive in a structured but fast-paced environment—comfortable following established processes/toolchain for quality and repeatability while staying flexible and creative to achieve ambitious goals.

D-Orbit is looking for a Senior Software Engineer & Team Lead to join our Cybersecurity Business Unit, based in Lisboa, Portugal.
In this role, you will provide technical leadership and strategic guidance to the development of secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions that support D-Orbit’s mission and long-term business objectives. Technical Direction & Architecture: Work closely with the Heads of Product and Technology to translate high-level architectural decisions into detailed implementation plans, making design and architecture choices that align with both project requirements and company software guidelines and standards.
Continuous Improvement & Hands-On Contribution: Actively contribute to the implementation of critical features while continuously identifying opportunities to improve processes, workflows, and tooling, introducing new technologies where they deliver tangible impact.
Code Quality & Engineering Practices: Oversee code reviews and enforce best practices across secure coding, testing, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring consistent quality and streamlined deployments. Proactively identify technical blockers and provide hands-on support to resolve them, keeping the team moving forward.
Team Leadership & Growth: Lead and mentor a small, focused security engineering team with a hands-on approach, fostering a collaborative culture that scales naturally as new talent joins and the team grows.
Development Coordination & Delivery: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex projects across the full software development lifecycle (from planning and bid preparation through design, execution, and deployment). Drive Agile/Scrum processes, monitor risks, dependencies, and constraints, and coordinate mitigation efforts across teams. Serve as the primary technical interface with customers, partners, and regulatory bodies, fostering transparent and collaborative relationships throughout the project lifecycle.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Collaborate across engineering, product, QA, DevOps, and business development teams, within the BU and across the wider organization, to ensure strategic alignment, clear communication, and a coherent technical direction from development through to market positioning.
Requirements:
Experience: Extensive experience in software development and architecture design (approximately 5 years), including a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects in time and within budget. Focus on Python language is strongly preferred.
Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
Microservices & Architecture: Deep understanding of system design and architecture, particularly with microservice architectures, and the ability to make decisions that ensure scalability and reliability.
DevOps & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with modern DevOps best practices – including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines – to accelerate development and deployment cycles.
Containerization: Proficiency with containerization and container orchestration tools, especially Docker and Kubernetes, for building and managing scalable applications.
Cloud: Experience deploying and running applications on AWS (or similar cloud platforms).
Linux: Strong knowledge of Linux/UNIX environments.
Leadership, Communication & Agile Mindset: Strong leader and communicator, able to mentor engineers, bridge technical and non-technical audiences, and run Agile/Scrum processes end-to-end. Pragmatic problem-solver with the foresight to anticipate risks and make sound decisions under uncertainty.
Preferred Qualifications:
Continuous Learning: Actively keeps up with emerging technologies and industry trends; contributions to open-source projects, community involvement, or recent training are a plus.
Cybersecurity Domain Knowledge: Solid background in cybersecurity, including secure coding, threat modeling, and monitoring. Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards is valued.
Space Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with ECSS standards (E40, Q80, M10), satellite communication protocols, encryption, and key management. Experience with ESA or EC projects and standard PM tools is a plus.

Engineering - Systems IVVQ
D-Orbit is looking for an Assembly-Integration-and-Verification (AIV) Systems Engineer to join our Systems Engineering team, based in Lomazzo (CO).
In this role, you will be responsible for the verification and validation of D-Orbit spacecraft platforms throughout the entire development lifecycle, ensuring compliance with system requirements and mission objectives. You will support the definition and execution of AIV, environmental and launch campaign activities, contributing to the successful qualification, integration and operational readiness of spacecraft systems.
You will work closely with Systems Engineering, AIV, Flight Operations, Hardware and Software Engineering teams, as well as external partners and launch service providers, and contribute to the delivery of reliable, mission-ready spacecraft, ensuring technical compliance, product quality and mission success.
Tasks and Responsibilities:
Plan the integration and testing of new satellites from components acceptance to launch campaign shipment;
Define and maintain the verification and validation strategy, model philosophy and plan, participating to the Assembly Verification and Integration (AIV) / Manufacturing-Assembly-Testing-Integration (MAIT) activities;
Define the systems and subsystems verification test plans and procedures;
Manage the systems-level and OBDH s/s functional verifications autonomously, including the test execution on the engineering models / flat-sat;
Work within a multidisciplinary team of specialists on the systems and s/s design;
Contribute to the systems and subsystems budgeting and integration within the project team;
Support systems- and subsystems- requirements capturing & management, with focus on verification;
Interface with prototyping technicians and with the launch campaign team during the V&V campaign;
Support the Flight Ops team for on-orbit validation activities throughout the mission execution.
Job Requirements:
Min 2 years of relevant work experience, preferably in space or other engineering domains, such as aeronautics.
Experienced and autonomous in the definition of test plans, test procedures and reports.
Knowledge of both theoretical and practical aspects of Test (functional testing, Electrical bonding/isolation, Vibration, TVAC;
Practical hands-on experience in test execution on engineering models / flat-sat or equivalent HW-SW testbench;
Knowledge of Systems Engineering principles and systems-level knowledge of all spacecraft subsystems, with particular emphasis on OBDH;
Knowledge of data bus architectures;
Knowledge of Health and Safety principles and their application to the specific environment;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Proactive attitude and ability to work in a team.
Experience in the use of Matlab and Python;
Knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
This role requires professional proficiency in English.
Nice-to-have skills:
DOORS / Jama requirements experience;
Knowledge of Linux.
Knowledge of ECSS/NASA standards.
